configurationContract.wiring: U_SEQ.5 FET_RELEASE → existing 1k → U1.30 DFETOFF; 47k and existing 100k to B0; remove Q_DFETOFF
configurationContract.prerequisite: Before any MAIN_REQ or FET_EN, hold host and power stages inhibited, confirm hardware FETs actually off, configure FET_INIT_OFF and 0xC2, read back configuration and FET status, and only then perform fresh precharge.
configurationContract.productionOtp: Program and verify 0x92FB=0xC2, FET_INIT_OFF=1, PDSG_EN=0, and PF_EN/OTPF enabled via existing I2C; no traction connection until done. This is a human production/commissioning requirement, not a claim already programmed.
configurationContract.resetBehavior: TI FAQ 1.8: short RST_SHUT preserves registers, so 0xC2 remains configured and asserted low DFETOFF disables FETs; full RESET or wake from SHUTDOWN reloads OTP and requires the specified OTP defaults. Short RST_SHUT preserves prior FET state independently and is not itself a turn-off command.
configurationContract.supplyFallLimitation: FET_RELEASE output and total DFETOFF injection must be bounded when PRE_CTRL_3V3 collapses; 47k/100k do not override an actively high output.

bufferInput.threshold: VIH >= 1.7 V at 2.3–2.7 V and >= 2 V at 3–3.6 V; intermediate threshold bounded by monotonicity assumption.
bufferInput.lossOf3v3: TPS3809 K33 falling threshold 2.87–2.99 V; reset propagation 10 us typical, no maximum, logic deassertion before 2.7 V not guaranteed for arbitrary fall slew.
bufferInput.senseDuringVddZero: SENSE independent, absolute maximum 70 V; no explicit unpowered leakage/backfeed bound.

supervisor.limitations: Static only; undervoltage propagation at small overdrive and fast supply collapse require actual waveform verification.

capacitorLeakageReference.condition: KEMET 100 V rated, +20 C, 5 minutes; not a 38 V, 0–60 C startup guarantee

limitations: Comparator errors and hysteresis reuse prior 442-ohm case assumptions; widened unbalanced ladder and monitor supplies need independent requalification.
FOC current additions are conditional maxima at differing datasheet test points; electrolytic leakage, converter startup and all other branches still need a full bound.
RLC numbers are ideal examples, not actual R/L lower bounds. Difference energy is total loop energy, not a per-MOS SOA guarantee.

External sources must be unable to inject during open-main test. Probe transistor VCE <= 2 V at full temperature for 4.1 s remains an engineering budget; 0.2 V is specified only at the 25 C/300 us test point.
Existing 300 W resistor 60 C free-air 253 W comparison applies only specified installation. Precharge MOS thermal and OFF tail are not qualified.
No physical circuit has been modified, powered, or validated.
This test detects an open main under the stated passive-load and no-source assumptions; it is not a calibrated milliohm measurement.

PRE_REQ/MAIN_REQ, phase-OR before main gate conduction, 70 ms dwell, 100 ms service, VCE <= 2 V across 4.1 s and full temperature, comparator saturation recovery, clock tolerance, actual R/L/SCD and MOS SOA require qualification.
Probe production test must verify its own resistor and switching. Normal charge is inhibited until BQ protection handoff and FOC local safety/ARM are established.
Once MAIN_PROVEN is set, existing MAIN_OR bypasses the precharge-window comparator; this must not be represented as continuous monitoring.
SC, MPPT, motor regeneration and other sources must not inject during test; measured injection and effective capacitance above the model require recomputation.
